Subject: Staff Serving Engineer — interview slate + leveling context

Hi team,

Quick sync request: we have a strong candidate (Chris Patel) for Staff Serving Engineer — I want to align on scope/leveling expectations and confirm the interviewer slate before Marissa finalizes the schedule. High-level context: Chris is currently an engineering lead at Acme Payments (payments infra, heavy latency work), has deep experience with long-sequence inference and production KV caching.

Asking for two things from you all:
- 10–15 minute read: confirm the probing focus for your interview (see proposed bullets below)
- Availability: confirm you can interview on the week of Sep 21 (I will share exact slots once you confirm)

Proposed interviewer focus (draft):
- Manager/Scope (me): ownership, prioritization, cross-team tradeoffs, long-term system design
- Infra/Systems (Lauren): batching, KV cache strategies, kernel/cost tradeoffs
- ML Serving Design (Monica): runtime behavior, failure modes, regression detection
- Senior IC / Bar-raiser (Aditya): leveling, ambiguous tradeoff problems, hiring bar check

Attachments: candidate-resume-chris-patel.pdf (resume), interview-rubric-staff-serving-v1.pdf (draft rubric). Please review and reply with any changes by EOD 9/14 PST so Marissa can lock calendar invites.

Thanks—
Mateo

Thanks for the context. A few thoughts on leveling and what I'd probe during the infra/systems interview:

- Leveling signal I care about: scope (breadth of systems owned), ownership over cross-cutting infra, and ability to convert model/algorithm constraints into system architecture tradeoffs.
- Focus bullets for my interview:
  * Large-scale KV/cache invalidation strategies and tradeoffs for multi-tenant workloads
  * How they'd design a fallback strategy for degraded model performance with minimal latency impact
  * Past examples where they led cross-team runtime optimizations and the measured impact (latency/cost)

On rubric: the current doc is a good start; recommend adding a short "data-driven impact" row for measurable outcomes (QPS/latency/cost). Happy to edit the doc directly — I'll add comments.

-Lauren

On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 14:20 Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> For bar-raiser: Aditya, can you explicitly call out the 2–3 non-negotiables you want to see for Staff-level?

Sure — quick bar-raiser checklist (to be included in the panel pre-read):
- System leadership: candidate must show examples of setting technical direction that affected multiple teams and can explain decision rationale and tradeoffs.
- Autonomous ambiguity handling: solves ill-defined problems end-to-end, defines success metrics, and drives cross-functional rollout.
- Production-minded rigor: demonstrates ownership for reliability and quantifiable impact (e.g., reduced p99 latency, cut inference cost by X%).

I'll also flag any concerns in my post-interview debrief if I don't see those signals.

Mateo — I can commit to Sep 22 (PST morning) as bar-raiser slot. Marissa — please hold a 60m block (45m interview + 15m debrief) for me.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao

Redwood Inference
